font-size: 12px; text-align: left; text-wrap-mode: wrap;"><b>Recursion: </b>revise features &amp; process proxies</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.4469" y="29" as="geometry"> <mxPoint as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="eRec_S5_S0" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;rounded=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#001DBC;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;curved=1;fillColor=#0050ef;startArrow=block;startFill=1;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="s0"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="150" y="490" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="390" y="790" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="710" y="200" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sg52twpyXZTqHOQ0uh68-3" connectable="0" parent="eRec_S5_S0" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontColor=light-dark(#000000,#000000);labelBackgroundColor=light-dark(#FFFFFF,#EDEDED);labelBorderColor=default;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px; text-align: left; text-wrap-mode: wrap;"><b>Recursion: </b>reframe question, scale, targets</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.3697" y="79" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="81" y="185" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note_parallel" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;arcSize=10;" value="Parallel paths are intentional:
Different abstractions produce different truths.

<span style="color:#075985;font-weight:700;">S1</span>: different observation pipelines
<span style="color:#14532d;font-weight:700;">S2</span>: different feature abstractions
<span style="color:#7c2d12;font-weight:700;">S3</span>: different structure models"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="296" x="64" y="412" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;movable=1;resizable=1;rotatable=1;deletable=1;editable=1;locked=0;connectable=1;" value="Core rules
1. No step is neutral
2. Every transformation loses information
3. Multiple representations are necessary
4. <span style="color:#7c2d12;font-weight:700;">Structure</span> is modelled, not discovered
5. <span style="color:#881337;font-weight:700;">Decisions</span> are justified, not computed
6. Reproducibility is mandatory
7. Interpretation belongs outside the code
8. <span style="color:#334155;font-weight:700;">Recursion</span> is required (S4/S5 may force redesign of S0–S3)"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="280" x="64" y="276" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fail" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;" value="Typical failure modes
• tools ≠ models
• <span style="color:#14532d;font-weight:700;">features</span> treated as reality
• assumptions hidden in code
• <span style="color:#881337;font-weight:700;">optimisation</span> before understanding <span style="color:#7c2d12;font-weight:700;">structure</span>
• overfitting spatial detail
• ignoring scale effects
• skipping the theory loop (no recursion)"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="306" x="64" y="536" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="succ" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;" value="Success criterion
You can explain:
• why a result looks as it does
• which assumptions created it (S0–S4)
• how it changes under different abstractions in <span style="color:#075985;font-weight:700;">S1</span>, <span style="color:#14532d;font-weight:700;">S2</span>, <span style="color:#7c2d12;font-weight:700;">S3</span>, <span style="color:#881337;font-weight:700;">S4</span>
• and when you must go back (recursion) to redesign earlier choices"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="1040" x="64" y="697" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rec_callout" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1;arcSize=10;fontSize=12;" value="Epistemic recursion (intentional):
When S4/S5 fail (or conflict), you do not 'debug' code first.
You revisit unit theory, process hypotheses, and scale choices in S0–S3."> <mxGeometry height="90" width="360" x="390" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sg52twpyXZTqHOQ0uh68-7" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;rounded=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#334155;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;curved=1;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;startArrow=none;startFill=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="760" y="557" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="770" y="607" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="715" y="557" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Sg52twpyXZTqHOQ0uh68-9" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;rounded=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#334155;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;curved=1;entryX=1;entryY=0.525;startArrow=none;startFill=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;entryPerimeter=0;" target="s1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="755" y="330" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="780" y="480" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="710" y="330" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
